items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: Gary Morton was there, and Lucille Ball, and I hadn't seen Gary in quite a while and so he saw me and he screamed John and we embraced

ctx.x: No, this is at Caesar's Palace. But it's a funny thing. This man -- Frank had tendonitis, in both hands, and at this particular time he just was recovering from an operation and he could hardly hold the microphone in his hand. And this particular morning that he got into this little set-to -- I was on my way to mass, about 4:30 in the morning, and I was going through the casino, and he had been in one of the little rooms in the lobby of Caesar's Palace. And Gary Morton was there, and Lucille Ball, and I hadn't…
In the meantime Frank came by and said, John, I'm going over and try my luck. Said fine, so my wife and I went
